subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / audit logs / DPA — Redwood <> Acme Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@acmehealth.com>, Brian Torres <brian.torres@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / audit logs / DPA — Redwood <> Acme Health

Hi Alice and Brian,

Thanks again for taking time today — good to meet you both. Recap from our call with your security and procurement teams and a proposed set of next steps. Please flag anything I missed.

Key pain points you shared:
- Audit log retention: compliance requires 7 years of immutable audit logs for access and admin activity.
- Evidence for SOC 2 + pen test: need machine-readable artifacts and a summary of findings for procurement review.
- DPA & data residency: want a DPA with explicit retention and deletion timelines, plus KMS/HSM options for key management.
- Access controls & separation: scoped service accounts and role-based access for engineering/infra teams.

Goals you articulated:
1) Confirm Redwood can meet 7-year audit log retention or propose a compensating control.
2) Get a SOC 2 Type II report and pen-test summary for red-team/third-party review.
3) Finalize DPA language and onboarding timeline so procurement can complete approval.

What we covered / commitments:
- Redwood provides a SOC 2 Type II report (2026) and a pen-test summary; full pen-test artifacts available under NDA.
- Audit logs: configurable retention options; by default 1 year hot, archive to S3-compatible object store for longer retention (immutable snapshots available).
- Encryption & KMS: support for customer-managed keys (KMS) and HSM integrations on Private deployments.
- DPA: we maintain a standard DPA; can provide a redlined copy and add clause for retention and deletion timelines.

Next steps / owners & proposed dates:
- Marissa (me): Share SOC 2 report and DPA draft by 2027-05-04 EOD. Attachment: SOC2-report-2026.pdf; Redwood_DPA-draft.pdf (see attachments/links).
- Neha (security): Coordinate pen-test summary and evidence under NDA by 2027-05-07.
- Rishi (infra): Schedule deep-dive call on audit log architecture and KMS options for 2027-05-10.
- Acme (Alice/Brian): Confirm whether 7-year retention is a hard requirement or if tiered retention with immutable archive is acceptable; share procurement deadline.

Attachments referenced:
- SOC2-report-2026.pdf (PDF, stub)
- Redwood_DPA-draft.pdf (PDF, stub)

Related links:
- Shared folder with supporting docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1Aq-example
- DocuSign placeholder for DPA: https://www.docusign.net/embeddedSigning/abcdef

If that all looks right I’ll send the artifacts and we’ll get the pen-test docs moving under NDA. Thanks again — looking forward to the next call.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0173

Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 17:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: SOC 2 / audit logs / DPA — Redwood <> Acme Health

Thanks Marissa — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

1) Retention: The 7-year requirement is in our regulatory scope (state-level health records). Tiered retention is acceptable if the data is immutably archived and searchable for audits.
2) Pen test: We need a high-level summary for procurement; the detailed findings will go under NDA. Can the pen-test summary call out CVSS scores and remediation status?
3) DPA: Procurement would like to see explicit deletion timelines and subprocessor list. We will circulate our standard redlines.

Procurement timeline: we are aiming to finalize contracts by 2027-05-20. If we can get SOC2 + DPA + pen-test summary this week or early next week, that would put us on track.

Thanks — Alice
Alice Zhang
Security & Privacy Lead, Acme Health
alice.zhang@acmehealth.com

Alice — thanks for the quick response and the timeline. Short replies and confirmations below plus concrete next actions.

Confirmations:
- Retention: We can support immutable archival for 7 years. Implementation options: (1) Redwood-hosted archive with object-lock snapshots (managed), (2) export to Acme-managed S3 bucket with object-lock & retention controls (preferred for customer-managed retention).
- Pen test: We can provide a one-page executive summary that includes CVSS scores and remediation status, and deliver full artifacts under NDA. Neha will coordinate the NDA and pen-test exports.
- DPA: I’ve attached our standard DPA and will accept redlines. We can add explicit deletion timelines and a subprocessor list for your review.

Action items (updated):
- Marissa: Share SOC2-report-2026.pdf and Redwood_DPA-draft.pdf (sent; links and attachments included) — target: 2027-05-04 EOD.
- Neha: Send pen-test executive summary + proposed NDA template — target: 2027-05-07.
- Rishi: Set up technical deep-dive on audit log architecture, KMS options, and export flow — proposed 2027-05-10 (I’ll send a calendar invite).
- Acme (Alice/Brian): Share any specific redlines for DPA and confirm final procurement date (you noted 2027-05-20).

If that aligns, I’ll: (A) upload the pen-test NDA to the shared Drive and (B) include a short architecture diagram in the deep-dive invite to make the audit log flow clear.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to keeping momentum.

Best,
Marissa
